entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi... um, I think I need to return something? I bought a helmet and I'm just so confused by the whole process.
I can certainly help you look into a return. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, I think so. It's... VF58291. It's just, the website had all these different pages and I couldn't figure it out.

No problem at all, VF58291. I see the order right here for the Urban Commuter Helmet, delivered eight days ago. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, a preference, I guess? The color just isn't what I thought it would be. I saw it online and it looked different. The box is still unopened, I haven't even taken it out.
I understand, getting the right color is definitely important. I just want to confirm that there's no issue with the helmet's quality or safety features, correct?
No, I don't think so. I mean, it's still in the plastic. I'm just so overwhelmed. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.
Of course, I can absolutely take care of this for you. Let me quickly review our policy for your item. One moment.
Okay, thank you for waiting. I've confirmed that your purchase is well within our 90-day return window. I've gone ahead and approved the return.
Oh, really? It was that easy? Thank you so much. That's a huge relief.

You're very welcome. I've just sent a prepaid return label to the email address on your account. Just print that out, attach it to the box, and you can drop it off at any shipping center. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again, David.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
